conditions: The Credits screen must carry the actual title, so not a placeholder: "Lost Time" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. The credit must be easy to find. The incompetech FAQ says the credit must not be "obscured". If the audio is edited (trimmed or crossfaded for the loop), the credits must make clear which parts are Mood Read's. Under CC BY 4.0 s.2(a)(5)(B), Mood Read must not add DRM or extra terms that stop people using the file. A public R2 bucket meets that. The license covers this recording only (ISRC USUAN1500032); it does not cover other versions.
